meta.name: FyAgent Cross-platform Glass Control Plane v3
meta.description: A calm Apple-inspired but platform-neutral desktop control plane for Windows and macOS, with six stable first-level capability pages.

color.palette_type: cool monochromatic with restrained cyan signal

primary.role: selected navigation and the single primary action

neutral.usage: pale blue backgrounds, white-blue glass surfaces, navy text

color.contrast_strategy: dark navy content over light translucent surfaces; blue is reserved for selection and primary action

font_families.heading: SF Pro Display, PingFang SC, Segoe UI Variable, sans-serif
font_families.body: SF Pro Text, PingFang SC, Segoe UI, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: native desktop cadence, no marketing display type, no text smaller than 12px

spacing.section_rhythm: 20px outer inset, 16px panel gap, 16–20px panel padding

layout.grid_system: platform-neutral desktop shell with 240px list, fluid workspace, 280px inspector
layout.alignment_tendency: strict left alignment with centered first-level navigation

shape.border_usage: 1px white highlight plus a low-alpha blue-gray outer border
shape.divider_style: single hairline dividers, never nested card borders

elevation.shadow_style: diffuse cool shadow with soft inner highlight
elevation.depth_cues: translucency, blur, inner highlight and one restrained shadow level per surface

iconography.style: rounded 1.75px outline icons with the filled Y gate mark

components.button_style: 40px primary pill, 36–40px secondary glass pill, one primary button per screen
components.input_style: 36–40px translucent field with clear navy text and blue focus ring
components.card_style: large glass panes for real grouping; list rows are not individual floating cards
components.navigation_pattern: six-item centered capsule; active item is solid blue
components.list_style: quiet contiguous rows with selected blue-tint state
components.inspector_style: single right glass pane for status, scope and contextual actions
components.window_controls: Windows controls at top-right in Windows shell; macOS native titlebar outside shared content

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a clear glass control surface over a soft sky field

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous around page title, compact within operational rows
visual_language.focal_strategy: active first-level capsule then the central workspace
visual_language.contrast_level: medium-high content contrast over low-contrast glass

composition.hierarchy_method: scale, selection tint and panel position
composition.flow_direction: top navigation, left selection, center work, right scope/status
composition.grouping_strategy: lists and inspectors, not card grids

interaction_feel.feedback_style: tint, border and concise status changes

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: one missing state plus one next action

overview.fallback_strategy: opaque pale-blue surfaces with the same hierarchy

background_effects.description: very pale blue/cyan light fields behind the shell

params.border_treatment: white inner highlight plus blue-gray hairline

visual_effects.composite_notes: The Apple influence is limited to material, spacing and calmness; window chrome remains platform-aware and the information architecture stays shared.
